project_name: Gam-Khuan Planetary Geological Solid-State Energy System
execution_model: The author provides the complete system architecture and intellectual property. Execution, funding, engineering, construction, and operation are carried out by licensed third-party entities under contract with the author.

core_1_sea_level_mitigation.design_statement: Transfer seawater from the ocean into a characterized coastal desert geological system and retain it there to produce measurable net reduction in global ocean mass.

core_2_solid_state_energy_storage.design_statement: Evolve the liquid brine into a solid-state salt-silica-carbon crystalline matrix serving as a massive non-metallic solid-state capacitor for grid-scale energy storage.
core_2_solid_state_energy_storage.primary_kpi: Energy density (Wh/L), dielectric constant, charge retention time.

twin_core_objectives.synergy: Both cores share the same infrastructure. Water transfer provides the material for the solid-state capacitor. The capacitor provides the energy storage that makes the system economically self-sustaining.

primary_mission.statement: Transfer seawater from the ocean into coastal desert formations and retain it there for centuries, while evolving the brine into a solid-state salt-silica-carbon energy storage matrix.
primary_mission.core_principle: The ocean is rising. Water must go somewhere. A coastal desert basin is the minimum viable unit for both sequestration and solid-state energy storage deployment.
primary_mission.why_this_matters: Global sea-level rise threatens coastal habitability. The world needs massive low-cost non-metal energy storage. This architecture addresses both with one integrated system.

system_architecture.description: Four integrated modules. Modules 1 and 2 serve Core 1. Modules 3 and 4 serve Core 2. Failure of one core does not invalidate the other.

module_1_conveyance.function: Move seawater from the ocean to the inland desert basin using gravity-fed pressurized tunnels or channels.
module_1_conveyance.design_principle: Gravity and natural elevation differences wherever possible. Minimize external energy input.

module_2_sequestration.function: Retain seawater in deep geological strata for long-term isolation.
module_2_sequestration.design_principle: Direct water into deep permeable layers, saline aquifers, and mineral-rich formations.

module_3_solid_state_energy_storage.function: Evolve liquid brine into a solid-state salt-silica-carbon crystalline matrix for massive energy storage.
module_3_solid_state_energy_storage.design_principle: Controlled evaporation and crystallization of brine with desert sandstone and a 3D conductive carbon percolation network.

phase_1_liquid.description: Immediate deployment using raw seawater/brine for double-layer capacitor storage while evaporation progresses.

phase_2_solid.description: Terminal solid-state crystallization into a salt-silica-carbon nano-composite dielectric material. Eliminates steam explosion risks, corrosion, and self-discharge.

module_4_energy_capture.function: Capture high-voltage atmospheric cloud static and lightning energy to bias and charge the solid-state matrix.
module_4_energy_capture.design_principle: Laser-induced plasma channels and carbon-fiber lightning masts. Tree-branching carbon cables (thick-to-thin) to distribute current and mitigate peak surge.
module_4_energy_capture.operational_role: Atmospheric Electrostatic Bias & Pulse Ignition subsystem. Enhances polarization of the salt-silica-carbon matrix.

phase_1_site_deployment.mission: Select, characterize, and deploy a single candidate coastal desert basin for both long-term geological seawater isolation and solid-state energy storage material development.
site_selection_criteria: Endorheic basin (no surface outflow to ocean)

geotechnical_specification.hydraulic_isolation: Chambers situated within ultralow-permeability host rock (Lugeon value < 0.01).
geotechnical_specification.site_characterization: 3D Reflection Seismic and Borehole Hydro-testing prior to excavation.
geotechnical_specification.site_rejection: Unresolved active fault zones interconnecting adjacent storage modules disqualify the site.

engineering_parameters.injection_pressure_budget: Formation pressure, fracture pressure, allowable injection pressure, pressure propagation, pressure dissipation, injection rate, cumulative injected volume, monitoring-well response.
engineering_parameters.permeability_feedback: Monitor Permeability(t) and Injection Pressure(t). Manage injection pressure to avoid geological hazards.
engineering_parameters.storage_vs_injection: Storage capacity does not equal injection capacity. The rate at which the formation can accept water is the critical engineering constraint.

core_innovations: Gravity-fed pressurized tunnel system for seawater conveyance
Deep-strata sequestration method for long-term water isolation
Salt-silica-carbon nano-composite dielectric material and manufacturing method
Tree-branching carbon-fiber lightning capture and distribution network
protection: Prior art defensive publication with cryptographic timestamping
Provisional patent applications for core mechanisms
Trade secret protection for advanced material doping and operational algorithms
